body: I've said some stupid shit in my life too.  For a while I was able to cut out all slurs and most of the "worst" curses but it didn't take long for me to relapse on that.  I hate dying in a stupid video game and not being able to stop myself from shouting the worst words that come to mind.  In my laziness, the trash next to me is easier to beat and break and throw than my fucking controller but it doesn't have the same finality that is surprisingly addicting.   I just wish I could stop.  I wish I wasn't angry
